title: Bài thi thử nói lớp 6
topics: My New School · My House · My Friends
note: Bài thi thử một lần, KHÁC dạng bài kiểm tra nghiên cứu: không tiếng bíp, không giới hạn thời gian, học sinh tự bấm khi sẵn sàng. Nhóm soạn theo Unit 1–3, chưa thầy cô duyệt. Không trùng đề A/B (test tự động kiểm tra).

questions.text: What do you usually do at break time at school?
How many rooms are there in your house?
Who is your best friend in your class?
What do you usually bring to school every day?
Do you like your new school? Why or why not?
Which room in your house do you like best? Why?
What is your best friend like, and why do you like him or her?
Would you like to live in a flat or in a house? Why?
A new classmate doesn't know anyone. What can you say to him or her?
Your friend is sad because of a bad mark. What would you say to your friend?
